title: removeRoles leaves channel permissionOverrides targeting the removed role
description: MemoryBackend apply_remove_role (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs) strips the role from members' roleIds but leaves channel Chat permissionOverrides[] entries with targetType "role" and targetId = removed id. Draft 5630c10 §Space/set removeRoles only says 'Members holding only removed roles are demoted to @everyone'; §ChannelPermission targetId is 'A SpaceRole id'. It does not say what happens to overrides. Since JMAP-yt1w.13, role ids are never reissued, so orphans are inert, not misbound. Decide: cascade-delete orphan overrides (and maybe propose spec text), or record that orphans are allowed.
notes: Folded into JMAP-y3f2 (Chat core server conformance (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00)) by the 2026-10-19 spec gap audit.
